info.name: KLAS API Testing
info.description:
System Integration Test Collection for KLAS (Kelas Absensi System).

Prerequisites:
1. Start local Supabase: supabase start
2. Run seed script: ./supabase/scripts/create-auth-users.ps1 -Local
3. Import the klas-local environment
4. Set anon_key in environment
5. Run 01-Auth folder first to get tokens

All endpoints use POST method and require Authorization header (auto-set via tests).
